records.rationale: Retain eight standard primary-plane RGB(A)/BGR(A) formats, matching virtio protocol translation and removal of the host-byte-order-only framebuffer gate/legacy preference. Pinned minigbm advertises ABGR8888/XBGR8888 among render formats; Goldfish DrmClient passes gralloc format to drmModeAddFB2. This deliberately accepts more userspace framebuffer formats than native LTS, while preserving native GEM handle lookup/references, allocation cleanup, framebuffer initialization and all later modeset checks. Plane code equals native apart from the format list and translation function; display code equals native after restoring exactly the removed gate/quirk. x86_64 is little-endian; no big-endian or visual output verification is claimed.
evidence: SECURITY.md: SDK virtual display formats and optional display features

records.rationale: Retain __PAGE_SIZE alignment for virtio dumb buffers. The local Goldfish x86_64_16k product uses page_shift=14, and the driver allocates backing shmem using the returned size. Without this change 4K-rounded buffers can be shorter than the emulated mmap granularity. Native zero-dimension/32-bit multiplication validation and output initialization remain, and args->size is u64 before alignment on the x86_64 target. This can increase padding by up to 12KiB relative to 4K alignment; native GEM allocation/lifetime stays intact. This resolves buffer sizing only, not the separately unresolved shared-file EOF page-compatibility question.
evidence: SECURITY.md: SDK virtual display formats and optional display features

The global ACK query found only the new test calls, but that absence is corroborating evidence rather than proof that no optional module could use it. Keep the complete native fixed-point header and existing rendering behavior; no general arithmetic bug fix is omitted.

records.rationale: Omit this ARM64-conditioned bridge-connector selection and expansion of the display-helper Kconfig gate.
